**issue:** The renderer emits publication-status lines before unit notes, while SPEC-004 §3 requires unit notes before the publication status map. Fixtures with both fields, such as F8, therefore produce generated goldens with the wrong contract order.

**Triggers:** When a release unit has both notes and publication status entries.

**Suggested fix:** Render `u.Notes` before `u.PublicationStatus` and regenerate the affected report goldens.

**issue (bug_risk):** Repository reasons are interpolated directly into GFM table rows, so a reason containing `|` creates extra columns and a reason containing a newline creates additional malformed rows. The report is not a safe single-line table when plan reason text contains arbitrary content. **Triggers:** When a repository reason contains a pipe or line break. **Suggested fix:** Escape `|` as `\|` for GFM cells and encode or normalize line breaks, such as replacing them with `
`.

**issue (bug_risk):** The renderer appends plan string fields verbatim, including possible CR or CRLF characters in titles, notes, prerequisites, conditions, reasons, stop details, and uncertainty text. Such a plan produces report bytes containing non-LF line endings, violating the report contract's required LF-only output.

**Triggers:** When any plan text field contains `\r` or `\r\n`.

**Suggested fix:** Normalize line endings in rendered text or reject plan fields containing carriage returns before rendering.

```suggestion
        return sb.ToString().Replace("\r\n", "\n").Replace('\r', '\n');
```

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve all normative plan facts in the report**

The renderer emits only the unit repository and packages here, dropping `releaseUnits[].basis`; elsewhere it also omits repository `evidenceKinds`/`confidence`, optional `delta.origin`, and contradiction claim package IDs. These are normative fields in `plan.v1`, and SPEC-004 §4.3 requires every plan fact to appear with nothing dropped. In current fixtures this prevents a merge reviewer from distinguishing assumed release units from evidenced ones or seeing evidence provenance and confidence. Render these facts in the report, or reconcile the conflicting acceptance criterion before treating the generated goldens as fidelity checks.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Escape arbitrary values before emitting table cells** When an input-backed reason contains `|` or a newline—for example, a `Fact.Path` or coverage-gap string embedded by `Planner`—this raw append creates extra GFM columns or rows, so the repository classification can be displayed under the wrong headings. The input schemas impose no restriction excluding these characters. Apply one table-cell escaping rule to every cell (at minimum escape `|` as `\|` and normalize CR/LF to a pinned single-line representation such as `
`) and cover both cases with a fixture. Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Emit unit notes before publication statuses**

For units containing both fields, these loops render publication statuses before notes, while SPEC-004 §3 explicitly orders unit notes first and the publication map second. The generated F-gate-transitive-conditional and F8 goldens therefore encode output that violates the report contract even though selftest passes. Swap the two blocks and regenerate those goldens.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

2\. Input text can forge report sections 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
Report.Render appends plan strings directly into headings, bullets and emphasized labels without
encoding Markdown syntax or line breaks. A newline in an input package name, note or gap detail can
introduce a heading or bullet that appears to be part of the plan.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Input text can change the report’s heading and list structure. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/UpgradeAuthority/Report.cs[12-19] - src/UpgradeAuthority/Report.cs[45-63] - src/UpgradeAuthority/Report.cs[88-92] ## Recommended Fix Encode dynamic text for its Markdown context, including newlines and syntax-significant characters, while keeping the renderer’s own headings and lists intact. Test inputs containing headings, bullets and emphasis markers. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

3\. Deleted report goldens still pass 🐞 Bug ☼ Reliability 
SelfTest defines reportOk as true when golden/report.md is absent. Removing any of the new
report goldens leaves its fixture counted as passing whenever its plan still matches.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The corpus check silently accepts a missing report golden. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/UpgradeAuthority/Program.cs[66-71] ## Recommended Fix Require report.md for fixtures in the report corpus and fail with a missing-golden message; make any intentional exceptions explicit rather than treating every missing file as a pass. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/09056b1f-0370-4c42-bb63-5973df8bd2b0?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/09056b1f-0370-4c42-bb63-5973df8bd2b0)

4\. Report byte differences can pass tests 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
SelfTest compares Report.Render with File.ReadAllText(reportPath) as decoded strings rather
than comparing UTF-8 bytes. A golden with a UTF-8 byte-order mark can therefore pass despite
differing from the BOM-free report bytes promised by the contract.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The report golden check cannot enforce byte-identical UTF-8 output. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/UpgradeAuthority/Program.cs[69-71] ## Recommended Fix Encode the rendered report as UTF-8 without a BOM and compare it against File.ReadAllBytes(reportPath). Test a BOM-bearing golden as a mismatch. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/029f43fa-3ee1-4831-924c-9fd95a6f7d07?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/029f43fa-3ee1-4831-924c-9fd95a6f7d07)

1\. Wave prerequisites look like they belong to the last unit only 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
Report.Render writes wave-level Prerequisites and Condition as two-space-indented bullets
after the unit loop, causing Markdown to attach them to the last unit rather than the wave. In
multi-unit waves, F3b places prereq: none under R6 only, F6 places the P1 prerequisite under RB
but not R8, and F2 places both fields under RX but not R3, misleading readers about which units the
requirements govern.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Wave-level prerequisites and conditions render as nested bullets under the last release unit, making requirements that govern the whole wave appear to apply only to that unit. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/UpgradeAuthority/Report.cs[45-63] - docs/specs/SPEC-004-report-and-cli.md[24-24] ## Recommended Fix Render prerequisites and conditions in a separately labeled wave-level block outside the release-unit list—for example, as top-level `- Prerequisites:` and `- Condition:` bullets with their items nested beneath them, or as a paragraph between the wave heading and unit list. Update SPEC-004 §3.3 to describe the intended GFM hierarchy, regenerate the 14 generated goldens, and hand-update F1. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/fa66d74b-43ce-4ee9-b985-ebb3fd9859c4?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/fa66d74b-43ce-4ee9-b985-ebb3fd9859c4)

5\. Pipe or newline in a reason breaks the repo table 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
Report.Render writes repository names, ownership values and joined reasons into GFM table cells
without escaping pipes or line breaks, and writes notes, gap details and stop detail into bullets
without collapsing newlines. A producer name, evidence path or reason containing | or a line break
can split a repository’s classification and explanation across cells or rows, while a newline in
bullet text can disrupt the bullet structure.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Arbitrary strings in GFM table cells can contain pipes or line breaks that alter the table structure; line breaks in bullet text can also disrupt its structure. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/UpgradeAuthority/Report.cs[69-71] - docs/specs/SPEC-004-report-and-cli.md[25] ## Recommended Fix Add a shared `Cell(string s)` encoder that replaces `\` with `\\`, escapes `|` as `\|`, and converts `\r\n`, `\n` and `\r` to a space or `
`. Apply it to every interpolated table cell. Collapse line breaks in notes, gaps, stop detail and prereqs; document the escaping rule in SPEC-004 §3; and add a fixture containing both a pipe and a line break. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/56163f3f-e2be-4902-b182-953e83448a15?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/56163f3f-e2be-4902-b182-953e83448a15)

6\. Report mismatches show the plan diff instead 🐞 Bug ◔ Observability 
SelfTest discards the rendered and golden report strings, then calls DumpDiff(golden, actual)
with plan strings even when the report comparison fails. When only report.md differs, those plan
strings are identical, so the failure shows (report.md mismatch) without any changed report lines.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Report-only self-test failures show a mismatch label but no changed report content. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/UpgradeAuthority/Program.cs[66-72] ## Recommended Fix Keep the rendered report and golden report text in variables. On failure, call `DumpDiff(golden, actual)` when the plans differ and `DumpDiff(reportGolden, reportActual)` when the reports differ. Render from the plan object already built rather than calling `LoadEngine(dir).BuildPlan()` a second time. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/998ef29d-f6f4-4464-885e-6c0c12deefef?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/998ef29d-f6f4-4464-885e-6c0c12deefef)

7\. Report leaves out several plan facts 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
Report.Render omits PlanUnit.Basis, PlanRepo.EvidenceKinds, PlanRepo.Confidence,
PlanDelta.Origin, and the PackageId of each contradiction claim. When a plan contains these
values, the human-readable report leaves reviewers without the release-grouping assumptions,
evidence strength, delta provenance, and claim-level package context needed for a merge decision.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The human-readable report omits populated plan fields needed to assess evidence, release grouping, delta provenance, and contradiction claims, contrary to SPEC-004 §4.3. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/UpgradeAuthority/Report.cs[45-85] - docs/specs/SPEC-004-report-and-cli.md[22-32] ## Recommended Fix Extend the report to show a ` - basis:` line per unit, repository evidence kinds and confidence in the table, contradiction claim packages such as `R1 (P5)`, and delta origin in the summary. Update the spec and hand-authored exemplar first, then regenerate and review the remaining goldens. If any fields are deliberately excluded instead, specify those exclusions exactly in the spec. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/03816039-d6fc-469f-9bc2-9c8b6afd372f?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/03816039-d6fc-469f-9bc2-9c8b6afd372f)

8\. Renderer prints publication before notes 🐞 Bug ⚙ Maintainability 
SPEC-004 §3.3 orders unit notes before the publication status map, but Render writes
publication: lines first and note: lines after. The F-gate and F8 goldens therefore have the
reverse of the order the spec describes, so the spec and the goldens disagree.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The spec and the renderer disagree on whether notes or publication lines come first within a unit. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/UpgradeAuthority/Report.cs[50-55] - docs/specs/SPEC-004-report-and-cli.md[24] ## Recommended Fix Pick one order. Either update the spec to say publication comes before notes, or swap the two loops and regenerate the F-gate and F8 goldens. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
